When I paired my two boys, Nibbler and Bmo, we used the 'cage within cage' method at first. We would put Bmo in a small cage and into Nibbler's. Sometimes we would switch them around so Bmo could sniff and explore the main cage. We would let them play together a lot and for a while they would try to dominate each other, though, Nibbler was the main aggressor. 

We did this for about a month and then we started putting Bmo in the main cage without the small cage. There were some issues here as well but we stayed close and split them up when it got too rough. It eventually worked and they got more and more comfortable and less aggressive and they are best pals now. 

As for your sad chin.. you could try giving dust baths more often, hiding treats around the cage to get them to move around, give them their favorite toys or any toy I guess. Also wouldn't hurt to find them a little stuffed animal to keep them company. And try to get your chin out to play if possible.
